verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents per-project dashboard views that cover part of the story. You can filter the dashboard by release and identify which release introduced errors, see release annotations on a timeline correlated with error rates, filter to errors introduced in the last 24 hours, and track stability against targets. It also groups events to show which issues have the biggest user impact. However, nothing shows an aggregated view across projects or teams, and regression-specific trend views are not evidenced. missing for 10: cross-project/cross-team rollup dashboards, explicit top-regressions view, independent or hands-on corroboration of trend dashboards.
